将 DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / Kimi / OpenRouter / Ollama 等外部大模型直接挂载进 Antigravity 左下角原生模型下拉菜单

🖼️ 界面预览  ·  ✨ 功能全景  ·  🧩 工作原理  ·  🚀 快速安装  ·  🧰 MCP 工具  ·  📂 数据存储  ·  🌌 苍蓝全家桶

面向 **Google Antigravity** 的原生主模型接入与侧栏可视化管理插件，与 **[苍蓝协奏台（External Orchestrator）](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-external-orchestrator)** 组成「苍蓝双子」：星轨让外部模型直接驶入左下角原生下拉菜单担任主脑，协奏台负责把重度工作委派给外部执行手。

🪐 直挂原生模型下拉菜单

一键 ★ 挂载 / 移除 任意外部模型到 Antigravity 左下角原生模型选择器，支持自定义显示别名与清理示例占位模型。

🔥 热读取零重启生效

底层代理每次请求实时热读取 ~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json，增删模型无需重启客户端，按 Ctrl+R 即可刷新菜单。

⚡ 与苍蓝协奏台一键同步

已配置苍蓝协奏台的用户可一键导入全部已启用提供商、密钥与模型列表并直接挂载，彻底告别重复填写。

🛠️ 适配 2.32+ ~ 2.35+ 补丁引擎

完整适配新版 ...spread（baseLsArgs）启动参数布局，支持原生中/英文下拉菜单实时搜索框与非破坏性共存注入。


原生主模型挂载管理
一键从苍蓝协奏台同步并挂载到左下角原生菜单，支持思考档位、Vision 标注与实时检索
多渠道管理与一键挂载
7 大主流渠道快速添加、单模型或整渠道一键挂载到左下角原生下拉菜单

### 1. 原生模型下拉菜单无缝挂载 - **直挂原生选择器**：选中任意外部渠道模型即可一键 **「★ 挂载 / 移除」** 到 Antigravity 左下角原生模型下拉框。 - **热读取零重启**：底层代理每次请求实时读取 `~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json`，挂载或卸载模型后无需重启客户端（若前端下拉列表尚未刷新，按一次 `Ctrl+R` 即可刷出最新模型）。 - **自定义显示别名与排序**：支持为挂载的模型设置清晰的显示名称，并一键清理默认示例占位模型。 ### 2. 多渠道管理、模型拉取与多关键词检索 - **7 大主流预设开箱即用**：内置 DeepSeek、本地聚合网关、OpenAI 兼容、Kimi / Moonshot、OpenRouter、Anthropic 兼容、Ollama 本地预设，支持自定义请求头（Headers）与超时设置。 - **一键拉取 `/v1/models`**：在渠道弹窗或列表中直接从远端接口拉取全部可用模型，支持空格分隔的多关键词实时过滤检索、单选/全选批量添加。 - **密钥隔离与自动脱敏**：API Key 仅保存在本机配置中，界面展示与 MCP 工具返回均自动掩码脱敏。 ### 3. 与「苍蓝协奏台」一键双向同步 - 已配置 **[苍蓝协奏台](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-external-orchestrator)** 的用户，只需点击 **「⚡ 从苍蓝协奏台一键同步并挂载」**（或「⇄ 仅从苍蓝协奏台导入渠道」），即可自动导入所有已启用的提供商渠道、密钥与模型列表，免去重复填写。 ### 4. Antigravity 2.32+ ~ 2.35+ 底层补丁引擎（`runtime/`） - **新版参数布局完整适配**：完美适配 `dist/languageServer.js` 在 Antigravity 2.32+ / 2.33.0+ / 2.35+ 下的 `...spread`（`baseLsArgs`）启动参数注入，并在原生中文/英文模型下拉菜单内提供实时搜索框。 - **非破坏性共存注入**：采用增量标记注入，与其他扩展补丁完全共存；支持在侧栏面板实时查看补丁状态，并一键在桌面生成「安装/更新星轨补丁」与「还原官方原版」批处理脚本。 ### 5. 苍蓝统一视觉与交互体系 - **Sidecar + 独立 Web UI 双形态**：采用 Antigravity 官方标准 Sidecar 辅助侧栏 + MCP Server 架构，彻底告别传统 Settings 弹窗 DOM 注入失效问题；点击顶栏 `Web UI` 可在系统浏览器全屏管理。 - **Neko Glass 毛玻璃界面 & 苍蓝主题色调中心**：支持深色/浅色切换、自定义毛玻璃下拉框与弹窗、6 套官方主题预设 + 自定义主副双色 + 4 个自定义栏位跨插件同步、左侧栏快捷入口开关与 GitHub Release 在线更新检查。

```mermaid flowchart LR A["苍蓝星轨 Sidecar / MCP"] -->|"热写入"| B["~/.gemini/antigravity/
custom_models.json"] O["苍蓝协奏台
External Orchestrator"] -.->|"一键同步渠道与模型"| A B -->|"每次请求实时热读取"| C["星轨本地代理
runtime/ 补丁引擎"] C -->|"注入模型列表 + 实时搜索框"| D["Antigravity 左下角
原生模型下拉菜单"] C -->|"转发请求"| E["外部大模型 API
DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama"] ```

> **前置要求**：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零第三方 npm 运行时依赖，纯 Node.js 原生 ESM 实现）。 ### 方式一 · 一句话让 Antigravity 帮你自动安装（推荐） 直接把下面这句话发给 Antigravity 即可自动完成克隆与核验： > 帮我把 `https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit.git` 克隆到本机 Antigravity 全局插件目录，目录名设为 `azure-orbit`，检查目录无误后告诉我，我再按 `Ctrl+R` 重载生效。 ### 方式二 · 命令行手动克隆 ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\azure-orbit" # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/azure-orbit ``` 1. **重启或重载 Antigravity（`Ctrl+R`）**，在右侧辅助面板或左侧栏打开 **「苍蓝星轨」**。 2. **首次激活底层补丁**：切换到 **「星轨引擎（底层补丁）」** 标签页，点击 **「在桌面生成安装/更新星轨补丁.bat」**，退出 Antigravity 后双击运行一次即可完成注入。 3. **挂载主模型**：在 **「模型渠道」** 页添加渠道或从苍蓝协奏台一键同步，点击模型将其挂载到 **「原生主模型」**，按 `Ctrl+R` 重载窗口后即可在左下角模型菜单中直接选用。

| 工具名 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `orbit_list_models` | 查看当前已挂载到左下角原生菜单的主模型、已配置渠道（脱敏）及底层补丁状态 | | `orbit_mount_models` | 将指定渠道的一个或多个模型直接挂载到 Antigravity 左下角原生下拉菜单 | | `orbit_unmount_model` | 从左下角原生下拉菜单移除指定模型，或一键清理默认示例模型 | | `orbit_sync_from_orchestrator` | 一键从「苍蓝协奏台」同步渠道与模型配置并可选直接挂载到原生菜单 | | `orbit_patch_status` | 检查 Antigravity 客户端 `app.asar` 的星轨底层补丁安装状态与版本兼容性 |

点击展开查看本机数据目录与苍蓝套件共享配置路径
- **原生挂载模型列表**：`~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json` - **星轨渠道与配置**：`~/.gemini/azure-orbit/config.json` - **苍蓝套件共享主题 / 左侧栏配置**：`~/.gemini/azure-theme.json`、`~/.gemini/azure-sidebar-nav.json`

**苍蓝套件（Azure Suite）** 9 款插件共享统一的 **Neko Glass 毛玻璃界面**、跨插件同步的 **苍蓝主题色调中心**（`~/.gemini/azure-theme.json`）以及可自由开关的 **左侧栏快捷入口**（`~/.gemini/azure-sidebar-nav.json`）： | 插件 | 仓库 | 核心能力 | | --- | --- | --- | | ✦ **苍蓝协奏台** | [antigravity-external-orchestrator](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-external-orchestrator) | 多渠道外部模型协同调度、自定义调度角色、容灾断路器与全链路实时监控 | | 🪐 **苍蓝星轨**  `✦ 当前仓库` | [antigravity-azure-orbit](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit) | 将外部大模型直接挂载进 Antigravity 左下角原生模型下拉菜单担任主脑 | | 🧭 **苍蓝罗盘** | [antigravity-azure-compass](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-compass) | Agent 工作模式预设中心、上下文水位监测与自动 /compact、苍蓝套件左侧栏总控 | | 🏛️ **苍蓝回廊** | [antigravity-azure-corridor](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-corridor) | 只读原生会话 FTS5 全文检索、自定义项目分组、优先级标签与独立安全归档箱 | | 🌌 **蓝汐 · 潮汐认知图谱** | [antigravity-lanxi-memory](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-lanxi-memory) | 五层纯 Markdown 真源记忆、CJK FTS5、潮汐遗忘曲线与交互式潮汐星海图谱 | | 💎 **苍蓝魂匣** | [antigravity-soul-md](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-soul-md) | 多人设卡热切换、工作区专属绑定、外接模型智能防掉线锚点与分层文件记忆 | | 💭 **思语中文** | [antigravity-think-zh](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-think-zh) | 内部思考语言简体中文 / 英文双档热切换、双通道防漂移与实时注入预览 | | 🔮 **苍蓝棱镜** | [antigravity-azure-prism](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-prism) | 原生 MCP App 思维链实时观测、免密钥零 Token 机翻与外部模型双通道译文 | | 🪄 **苍蓝魔杖** | [antigravity-azure-wand](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-wand) | Windows 桌面与网页低打扰操控台、独立输入 15 状态 AI 光标、套装画廊混搭与外部光标导入 | ---

🖼️ Preview  ·  ✨ Features  ·  🧩 Architecture  ·  🚀 Quick Start  ·  🧰 MCP Tools  ·  📂 Storage  ·  🌌 Azure Suite

Native primary-model injection and visual provider management for **Google Antigravity**. Pairs with **[External Orchestrator](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-external-orchestrator)** as the *Azure Twins*: Azure Orbit mounts external models directly into the native selector, while External Orchestrator delegates heavy tasks to external workers.

🪐 Native Model Selector Mounting

One-click ★ Mount / Unmount any external model into Antigravity's native bottom-left dropdown, with custom aliases and sample cleanup.

🔥 Hot Reload, Zero Restarts

The local proxy hot-reads ~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json on every request—no app restart required (press Ctrl+R if the UI list needs a refresh).

⚡ One-Click Orchestrator Sync

Already configured External Orchestrator? Sync all enabled providers, keys, and model lists with a single click—zero duplicate setup.

🛠️ Antigravity 2.32+ ~ 2.35+ Engine

Fully adapted to the new ...spread (baseLsArgs) layout with a built-in search box inside the native dropdown and non-destructive coexisting patches.


Native Primary Models
One-click sync from External Orchestrator, thinking tiers, Vision badges & live search
Multi-Provider Management
7 quick-add provider presets with single-model or batch mounting to the native dropdown

### 1. Seamless Native Model Selector Mounting - **Mount Straight into the Native Selector**: Select any external provider model and click **★ Mount / Remove** to expose it directly in Antigravity's bottom-left model dropdown. - **Hot-Read with Zero Restarts**: The underlying proxy reads `~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_models.json` live on every request; press `Ctrl+R` to refresh the frontend dropdown whenever needed. - **Custom Aliases & Cleanup**: Assign clear display aliases for mounted models and clear default placeholder entries in one click. ### 2. Multi-Provider Management & Multi-Keyword Model Discovery - **7 Built-in Provider Presets**: DeepSeek, Local Aggregator Gateway, OpenAI-Compatible, Kimi / Moonshot, OpenRouter, Anthropic-Compatible, and Local Ollama, with custom headers and timeout controls. - **One-Click `/v1/models` Fetching**: Fetch all available remote models directly in the modal, filter with space-separated multi-keyword queries, and batch-add selected models. - **Local Key Isolation & Masking**: API keys stay strictly on your machine and are automatically masked in both the UI and MCP responses. ### 3. One-Click Sync with External Orchestrator - Users of **[External Orchestrator](https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-external-orchestrator)** can click **⚡ Sync & Mount from Orchestrator** (or **⇄ Import Providers Only**) to pull all enabled providers, keys, and models automatically. ### 4. Antigravity 2.32+ ~ 2.35+ Runtime Patch Engine (`runtime/`) - **Modern Argument Layout**: Fully supports `dist/languageServer.js` `...spread` (`baseLsArgs`) injection in Antigravity 2.32+ / 2.33.0+ / 2.35+, plus a live search filter inside both Chinese and English native model dropdowns. - **Non-Destructive Coexistence**: Uses incremental marker injection to coexist cleanly with other extensions; inspect patch status in the panel and generate one-click Desktop install/update or restore scripts. ### 5. Unified Azure Suite UI - **Sidecar + Standalone Web UI**: Built on Antigravity's official Sidecar + MCP Server architecture; click `Web UI` in the header to manage providers fullscreen in your browser. - **Neko Glass UI & Azure Theme Center**: Dark/light themes, custom glass dropdowns & modals, 6 official presets + custom dual color pickers + 4 cross-plugin custom slots, sidebar toggle, and GitHub Release update checks.

> **Prerequisite**: **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero third-party npm dependencies, pure native ESM). ### Option 1 · Let Antigravity Install It for You (Recommended) Copy and send the following prompt directly to Antigravity: > Please clone `https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit.git` into my Antigravity global plugins directory as `azure-orbit`, verify the directory structure, and tell me once it is ready so I can press `Ctrl+R` to reload. ### Option 2 · Manual Git Clone ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\azure-orbit" # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/A16Nights/antigravity-azure-orbit.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/azure-orbit ``` 1. **Restart or reload Antigravity (`Ctrl+R`)**, then open **Azure Orbit** from the sidebar or right-hand panel. 2. **First-time runtime patch**: Open the **Orbit Engine (Runtime Patch)** tab, click **Generate Desktop Install/Update Patch Script**, close Antigravity, and double-click the generated script once. 3. **Mount models**: Add providers (or sync from External Orchestrator), mount desired models to **Native Primary Models**, press `Ctrl+R`, and pick them straight from the bottom-left dropdown.

| Tool | Description | | --- | --- | | `orbit_list_models` | List mounted native models, configured providers (masked), and runtime patch status | | `orbit_mount_models` | Mount one or more models from a provider directly into Antigravity's native bottom-left dropdown | | `orbit_unmount_model` | Remove a mounted model from the native dropdown or clear default sample entries | | `orbit_sync_from_orchestrator` | Sync providers and models from External Orchestrator with optional immediate mounting | | `orbit_patch_status` | Inspect Antigravity `app.asar` Orbit patch status and version compatibility |
